vishal: draft Python snippet pushed:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
ctx = c.new_trace('obs-cookbook')
ctx.set_tag('cost_center','batch-jobs')  # used in dashboards to attribute spend
# tip: c.config.max_batch_tokens = 1024  # higher -> lower unit cost, higher p95
resp = c.dashboards.render(ctx, 'troubleshoot-compact')
print(resp.share_url)
```

sam: dashboard YAML (minimal) draft:
```yaml
widgets:
  - name: latency-p50
    metric: redwood.request.latency.p50
  - name: latency-p95
    metric: redwood.request.latency.p95
  - name: errors
    metric: redwood.request.errors.rate
  - name: cost-1k
    metric: redwood.request.cost.usd_per_1k
```

jen: recipes:
- p95 spike: check MaxBatchTokens, KV cache hit-rate, recent model rollouts. remediation: reduce batch size, warm kernels, rollback if regressions.
- KV cache misses: symptom: traffic with high cold-start p95. remediation: enable prefix caching and increase cache TTL.
- cost anomaly: symptom: cost uptick w/o traffic increase. remediation: check model variants, quantization changes, and routing rules.
